notes: The supplied 'are*' goes to the subject article under rule 53's noun-phrase-predicate exception, the subject being pronominal in the sense of rule 68; putting it on the relative-pronoun unit instead is defensible.
ῥίζαν οὐκ ἔχουσιν: the noun is not a negative indefinite, so οὐκ keeps the English 'no'.
